motion.reducedMotion: all durations resolve to 0ms; springs and ring loops are off (rings stay static, sheets and cards cross-fade over motion.fast, keys show the pressed state by colour without travel); the logo shows its final frame

elevation.raised: a hard ink edge below the element (keycap), never a soft or blurred shadow

_rules: Colour is evidence or brand. Signal pink (signal.500) marks primary actions and brand surfaces only; it never says anything about an answer (ADR-015).
Never white or card text on signal.500 (3.5:1). Text on Signal is ink.900; pink text on a light surface is signal.deep.
The four truth colours are reserved and never used for buttons, charts or accents.
A filled badge means a human verified it. A dashed outline means the web did.
No soft or blurred shadows. Elevation is a hard ink edge (elevation.keyEdge on keys, elevation.cardEdge on cards) that drops when pressed (ADR-015).
Radius rises with the size of the element. One radius on everything is a component-kit default.
The headline on a result screen is the value, not a sentence.
No dark mode in V1. If added, a separate contrast-audited set — never the light palette at low opacity.
A circle means a person: you, or someone nearby. It is never decoration and never a count the server did not send.
Field and control borders use rule.control (3:1 or better against card and paper, WCAG 1.4.11).
Display type is Bricolage Grotesque (type.family.display) on web and iOS; iOS body text stays the system face so Dynamic Type works unchanged.
